name: Elevation Profile
description: The shape of a route from the side: altitude against distance, tinted by steepness, with flagged waypoints, a scrubber and total ascent and descent.

props.name: points
props.description: Altitude in metres along the route, by distance in kilometres. Ascent and descent are summed from these points.

props.name: waypoints
props.description: Named places along the route, marked with small flags. Labels stack so they never overlap each other or the terrain.

props.name: onScrub
props.type: (state: { km: number; m: number; gradient: number } | null) => void
props.description: Called as the scrubber moves, with the distance, altitude and gradient under it, or null when it leaves. Use it to move a marker on a map.

props.name: steep
props.description: The gradient, as a fraction, that takes the deepest tint. Gentler ground is paler.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width follows the card.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the gradient scale under the plot.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: A title beside the vertical axis, set sideways. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the profile shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card, e.g. the route name.

props.name: value
props.description: The headline. Defaults to the route's length.

props.name: caption
props.description: Text after the headline. Defaults to total ascent and descent.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the gradient scale under the plot.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts note, action and every other prop of a div.
